newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso pares initial gains on short dlr cover.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso pares initial gains on short dlr cover.

text.p: The Mexican peso reined in earlier gains against the dollar in mid-morning trade on Wednesday as dealers as dealers covered short dollar positions, traders said.
"A rate of less than 7.80 pesos per dollar was good for covering (dollar) shorts," one trader said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour stablemate stood 0.05 and 0.1 of a centavo firmer, respectively, at 7.7950/7.7990 and 7.7910/7.7950 per dollar.
Same-day peso contracts had meanwhile closed 0.8 of a centavo firmer at 7.7850/7.7900 per dollar.
